description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Injector_PurifierLinkify that extends HTMLPurifier_Injector, responsible for converting configuration directive syntax %Namespace.Directive into clickable links within HTML content. It provides functionality to process text tokens, identify directive patterns, and wrap them with anchor tags linking to URLs specified via configuration.
external_methods: PHP string functions: strpos, preg_split, str_replace

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_PurifierLinkify
classes.description: An injector class for converting directive syntax in HTML content to hyperlinks based on configuration.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the object with configuration parameters, specifically fetching the URL template for links.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Processes text tokens to identify directive patterns and replaces them with appropriate hyperlink tokens.
